minutes.headline: Open Space Committee took no vote on Parmenter Road; chair will write the Select Board a letter noting concerns first.
minutes.summary: The committee heard a draft memo and long public comment, mostly from Ruth Street and Johnson Street neighbors opposed to car-top kayak access at the Parmenter Road parcel. Members were split between recommending transfer of care and control to Parks and Rec and doing more due diligence first. No recommendation was voted; the chair will draft a letter to the Select Board, and Parks Commission members will research concerns before the March meeting.

what_happened.line: The Open Space Committee took no vote on whether to recommend moving the Parmenter Road parcel to Parks and Rec for car-top kayak access.
The chair volunteered to draft a letter to the town manager and Select Board noting concerns to be evaluated before any transfer of care and control, without recommending one.
Public comment, mostly from neighbors, opposed the site, citing traffic, safety at the intersection, limited parking, and possible ADA costs to the town.
Members were split between recommending transfer and doing more due diligence first; the Parks Commission chair will compile and research the concerns.
The next meeting stays on March 8th with the vice chair running it; April 12th follows.

why_it_matters: Whether the Parmenter Road lot becomes a public lake access point is still open, and the Select Board will have the committee's concerns, not a recommendation, when it considers any transfer of the parcel.
Neighbors raised possible ADA compliance costs to the town, a cost question that residents have not seen answered in this meeting.
watch_next: Open Space Committee meeting on March 8th, with the Parks Commission's research on the raised concerns possibly ready then or within a couple of months.
The chair's letter to the town manager and Select Board, not yet drafted at this meeting.
